homework.title: Comic Book Memory Lane
homework.description: Before the next session, I want you to do one thing. Don't look for a new comic. Instead, find one of your old Spider-Man comics that you used to love. Just hold it. Don't even read it. Just hold it and notice one thing about how it feels in your hands—is it heavy or light? Is the cover glossy or matte? That's it. No thinking about liking it or not. Just the physical action of holding an old favorite.

homework.title: Five-Minute Environment Shift
homework.description: This isn't about comics at all. Sometime before we meet again, I want you to change your physical environment for exactly five minutes. If you usually look for comics at your desk, go sit on the floor, or stand by a window. Or if you're usually in your room, go to the kitchen. Just be in a different spot for five minutes. You don't have to do anything there—no comics, no phone. Just be there. Notice one thing you see in that new spot that you don't usually notice.
